LBY.note: SMS voter registration is not an ID authentication service.
Only voter-registration counts, not ID enrolment.
Nothing on operating the ID system.

facts.fact: Libya's High National Elections Commission (HNEC) says voters register for the municipal elections by SMS to 17017 with their national ID number and polling-centre number, and published a voter list of 560,896 registered as of 13 April 2025.

LBY.note: Nothing on the ID system itself.
Nothing on local government office connection.
Displacement mentioned only as background, no registration or access.
